episodes.title: Ett öga mot skyn
episodes.summary: Young Ronja learns to protect herself from the dangers of the Mattis Woods while Borka and his robbers cause Mattis trouble.

episodes.title: Rövarhövding
episodes.summary: At Hell's Mouth, Ronja unearths a disturbing secret about the Borka robbers. In the village, Halvert is under pressure to make the forest safe.

episodes.title: Stupstocken
episodes.summary: Ronja learns something shocking about the robbers' way of life, while Mattis recruits a new member for the clan. Birk and Ronja meet again.

episodes.title: Första snön
episodes.summary: Ronja and Birk secretly spend their autumn days together in the forest, while Mattis creates obstacles for Borka. Cappa has a new plan.

episodes.title: Min bror
episodes.summary: Winter separates Ronja and Birk, who must remain inside the Mattis Fortress and the Borka Keep. Ronja learns why her father hates Borka.

episodes.title: Vårskrik
episodes.summary: It's spring and Ronja and Birk can finally reunite in the Mattis Woods. Mattis suspects that a robber stole food from the pantry during winter.

episodes.title: Jag har inget barn
episodes.summary: Cappa and her knights are after Ronja and Chegge while Mattis enacts a shocking plan to get rid of Borka once and for all.

episodes.title: Vildmarken
episodes.summary: Everything has changed in the Mattis Fortress. Ronja and Birk weigh their options as their fathers' strife deepens.

episodes.title: Björngrottan
episodes.summary: Both the knights and the wile-wings are after Ronja and Birk, who must find a new refuge. Their friendship is put to a test.

episodes.title: Mattis
episodes.summary: The Mattis robbers struggle to get their chief back on his feet, and ask Ronja to return home. Cappa makes a new plan to capture Mattis.

episodes.title: Hemkomst
episodes.summary: Lovis has had enough of Mattis' antics. Ronja receives a surprise guest and Birk worries about the future, while Cappa reveals what is haunting her.

episodes.title: Ett rövarband
episodes.summary: Mattis and Borka come head-to-head as Cappa makes her final attempt at revenge. A new phase of life begins, and Ronja must say a difficult goodbye.
